description: Opens a business's privacy policy, SMS terms and opt-in page (public https links) and checks what US carrier reviewers look for before approving an A2P 10DLC texting campaign: the non-sharing statement and no wording that lets mobile data go to third parties (Twilio 30908, 30932), frequency, "Message and data rates may apply", STOP and HELP in the terms, and an opt-in that is never pre-ticked (30924). Returns verdict and pass/warn/fail checks per page. Pattern checks, not a carrier's decision; nothing is stored.
name: check_a2p_10dlc_documents
title: Check A2P 10DLC documents before registering
